tier.ui:help: Select the Azure Functions hosting plan. Consumption: Pay per execution (ideal for variable workloads). Flex Consumption: Hybrid on-demand + always-ready instances. Premium: Reserved capacity with faster cold starts.

region.ui:help: Select the Azure region where your function app will be deployed. Regional pricing varies significantly.

consumption_tier.ui:title: Consumption Plan Pricing
consumption_tier.ui:help: Configure pricing parameters for Consumption plan. You pay for GB-seconds of execution and number of requests.

memorySize.ui:help: Memory allocated per function execution. Higher memory = faster execution (billed per GB-second).

executionCount.ui:help: Estimated number of function invocations per month. First 1M executions/month are free.

executionTime.ui:help: Average duration of each execution in milliseconds. Billed in 100ms increments.

flexconsumption_tier.ui:title: Flex Consumption Plan Pricing
flexconsumption_tier.ui:help: Configure on-demand and always-ready instance settings for Flex Consumption plan.

instanceMemorySize.ui:help: Memory allocated to each function instance. Larger instances support higher concurrency.

onDemandExecutions.ui:help: Total on-demand executions per month (in units of 10, so 100 = 1,000 executions).

onDemandExecutionTime.ui:help: Total active execution seconds per instance per month for on-demand workloads.

onDemandInstances.ui:help: Number of active on-demand instances running concurrently.

alwaysReadyEnabled.ui:help: Enable Always-Ready instances for baseline guaranteed capacity (reduces cold starts).

alwaysReadyInstances.ui:help: Number of always-ready instances to keep warm continuously.

alwaysReadyBaselineExecTime.ui:help: Baseline execution seconds per always-ready instance per month.

alwaysReadyTotalExecutions.ui:help: Total always-ready executions per month (in units of 10).

alwaysReadyActiveExecTime.ui:help: Active execution seconds per always-ready instance per month (beyond baseline).

alwaysReadyActiveInstances.ui:help: Number of always-ready instances handling active workloads beyond baseline.

premium_tier.ui:title: Premium Plan Pricing
premium_tier.ui:help: Configure premium instance sizing and billing options. Premium offers dedicated compute with guaranteed baseline capacity.

instance.ui:help: Premium instance tier. EP1: 1 core, 3.5 GB RAM. EP2: 2 cores, 7 GB RAM. EP3: 4 cores, 14 GB RAM.

billingOption.ui:help: Pay-as-you-go (PAYG) or Savings Plans (1-year or 3-year commitment for discounts).

preWarmedCount.ui:help: Minimum number of pre-warmed (always running) instances. Baseline capacity.

preWarmedHours.ui:help: Hours per month the pre-warmed instances will be running (max 744 hours = full month).

additionalUnitsCount.ui:help: Additional scaled-out instances for peak capacity beyond pre-warmed baseline.

additionalUnitsHours.ui:help: Hours per month the additional scaled-out instances will be active.
